webFetch.timeoutSeconds.label: Spider Fetch Timeout
webFetch.timeoutSeconds.help: Maximum time CrawClaw waits for static HTTP or Spider browser-rendered fetches.

webFetch.maxChars.label: Spider Fetch Max Characters
webFetch.maxChars.help: Maximum extracted characters returned by the Spider fetch provider.

webFetch.render.label: Spider Fetch Render Mode
webFetch.render.help: Default render mode for web_fetch requests when the tool input does not specify one.
